results.rationale: Consistency: the open wooden grid is replaced by a smaller stone-framed board, with numerous stones added and existing colors/positions changed. Instruction: black rows appear, but the requested single winning stone is replaced by a wholesale new game configuration. Knowledge: a win from one legal addition to the original position is not depicted; Instruction failure implies knowledge invalid. Quality: several white pieces have anomalous dark upper halves and blurred boundaries, although the board remains recognizable.

Consistency: the room layout persists, but carved wall-panel detail and bedding/pillow textures are noticeably redrawn. Instruction: balloons are added in the room, but a floating cluster of five replaces the requested single regular-air balloon. Knowledge: none lies on the floor as the supplied explanation requires, fundamentally contradicting that behavior. Quality: the room and balloon bodies are coherent, with minor blending/tangling of ribbons beneath the cluster.
